text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ouch☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainy-P, Trainy-P! I think I'm suddenly
gettin' bad pain vibes, like, totally intense★
choice_data_list: Could it be... your leg is hurting?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Urgh, my mouth... Is this, like, that thing?
Cavity zombies going yaaaay?
choice_data_list: A cavity!? Let's go to the dentist.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That's seriously hilarious~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ――Outing extended. Dragging a giggling Daitaku Helios along, we rushed to the dentist.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
The dentist, huh. Hey...
This sound... It's kind of...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whirrrr, whirrrrrrr!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I am soooooooo hyped right now★
Isn't the feel of these wheels insanely sick!?

text_block_list.name: Dental Receptionist
text_block_list.text: Number 18, please come in.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Okie-dokie, comin' right up♪ I'm the outermost gate?
Then I'll just cut inside♪ Much appreciated☆"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Daitaku Helios happily bounced into the infirmary, and then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Whirrrr, whirrrrrrr!!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayyy★ Spin it more, spin it☆
Vroooooooom♪

text_block_list.name: Dentist
text_block_list.text: Okay, open wide—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahahahahah!
Ababababababababababaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. They kicked me out for a sec and told me not to stick my tongue out when opening my mouth~. Like, chill out.
So annoying...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Wait, don't people usually stick it out when they open their mouth? Like 'bleeeh'?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems to be a habit of hers.
She appears to have avoided the doctor, and as I wondered what to do...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no waaaay! Let me go, Nature~.
Turbo's not getting any treatmeeeent.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Helios?
Wait, do you have a cavity too?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: It's Turbo and Nature! Ahahaha, Turbo having a cavity too is seriously hilarious~☆

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The runaway front-runner, Twin Turbo,
was also dragged in for cavity treatment.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Turbo, don't freak out, don't panic, just enjoy the ride☆
AHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
No no no waaaay!!!!!!
Turbo hates the dentist! Go awaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One of them is far too positive, and the other far too negative, making things completely chaotic.
In this situation—"
choice_data_list: Let's split the difference between the two of you.
A race between the two of you.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Add 'em up... and divide by two? Ah, like me and Turbo
sharing our high vibes and low vibes?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Half motivated and half reluctant, huh...
Is that even possible...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the two of them entered the clinic at the same time—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ayy ayy ayyy★
Don't mess with me, let go, seriously forgive me, Hey!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Time to fight through the pain!! Ooooh!!
No, no, no, noooooo!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...The chaos didn't subside in the slightest.
Until the treatment was over, the dentist's office remained
in full-blown party mode.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whoever can stay quieter wins.
If I appeal to their competitive spirit...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“A race...?
Ah, Turbo, wanna go with that?”

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! We're not gonna just sit around
quietly in a place like this!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Full throttle breakaway from things I hate!! Turbo power to the max!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If it's front-running, I'm not gonna lose either☆
Ayy-ayy★ Let's kick off an intense chase!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The two burst out of the dentist's office and broke into a sprint.
It's great that they're energetic, but...
I'll have to bring them back for treatment another time.
